label: Aged Shelf Corporations
title: Aged Shelf Corporations & LLCs
hero: Choose an entity with its history in view.
intro: Aged corporations and LLCs are available in approximately 48 states, with delivery often available within one business day. New and foreign entity filings are also offered in all 50 states.

items.title: Aged corporations & LLCs
items.text: Ask about current inventory, entity age, state, status, and transfer documents before selecting an entity. Availability and timing vary.

items.title: New & foreign filings
items.text: New entity formations and foreign qualification filings are offered across all 50 states. State requirements, fees, and processing times differ.

items.title: C corporation
items.text: A corporation is a separate legal entity. Formation, governance, ownership, and tax considerations depend on the state and business plan.

items.title: S corporation election
items.text: S corporation status is a federal tax election for eligible entities and owners, with IRS requirements. Confirm eligibility with a CPA or tax attorney.

items.title: Limited liability company
items.text: LLC requirements, management, and tax treatment depend on the formation state and tax elections. Review the structure with an attorney or CPA.

items.title: Mail & privacy options
items.text: Mail services and privacy options are available in select states. Ask what is available for the jurisdiction you choose.

note: An entity’s age alone does not establish operating history, revenue, creditworthiness, or eligibility for financing or contracts. Review its records and status before purchase.

label: Credit Repair / Credit Sweep
title: AI-Powered Credit Sweep & Dispute Letters
hero: Let AI help build the letter. You stay in control.
intro: An AI-powered platform helps draft credit-report dispute letters in minutes for items you believe are inaccurate, incomplete, or unverifiable. You review and approve each draft before sending. No removal of accurate, current information or credit-score increase is promised.

items.title: AI-assisted letter drafts
items.text: The platform helps create dispute-letter drafts in minutes. Review every statement, correct anything that is wrong, and send only information you know to be true.

items.title: You stay in control
items.text: Review, edit, and approve every letter before sending. The service is offered without an agency engagement or retainer; you decide whether and when to send each draft.

items.title: Dispute only real errors
items.text: Use dispute support for information you have a good-faith reason to believe is inaccurate, incomplete, or unverifiable. Do not dispute accurate information or submit false identity-theft claims.

items.title: Know your rights and terms
items.text: You can dispute errors directly with credit bureaus and furnishers. Review the service contract, fees, cancellation terms, timing, and refund policy before paying.

note: Credit-repair services cannot legally promise to remove accurate, current negative information. Ask about your rights and costs before signing. The FTC explains that consumers can dispute credit-report errors themselves at no cost.
